meta.name: deep-research
meta.description: Multi-source deep research using firecrawl and exa MCPs. Searches the web, synthesizes findings, and delivers cited reports with source attribution. Use when the user wants thorough research on any topic with evidence and citations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索多源信息并生成带引用的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速获取多源信息并生成有据可查的调研报告
copy.tagline_en: Search multiple sources and generate cited research reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather multi-source information and produce cited research reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会从多个网站搜索信息，综合整理成带引用来源的研究报告。报告包含摘要、主题分析、关键结论和来源列表。
howto.when: 当你要求深入研究某个话题，或说出“研究”、“深度调查”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 研究一下核聚变能源的现状
say.note: Claude 会搜索并生成一份带引用的报告。

say.text: 深度调查 Rust 和 Go 在 2026 年后端服务中的对比
say.note: Claude 会分解问题、搜索并综合结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude searches multiple websites, synthesizes findings, and produces a cited research report with executive summary, thematic analysis, key takeaways, and source list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for in-depth research on a topic or use keywords like "research", "deep dive", "investigate".

say_en.text: Research the current state of nuclear fusion energy.
say_en.note: Claude will search and generate a cited report.

say_en.text: Deep dive into Rust vs Go for backend services in 2026.
say_en.note: Claude will break down the question, search, and synthesize.
